about: wc-001 and task 010 lab falsifiers. Each one plants a bug in the capsule source, the build script, this capsule's manifest (capsule/capsule.json), the tools crate or the reproducibility copy, and requires every one of its named tests to FAIL at an assertion (a test harness that does not compile, or no matching test, does not count). wc-001: F-WC1 embeds an absolute build path so the two clean builds differ; F-WC1-SPACED-PATH splits the remap flags on a space in the build path; the rest change the digest result, retain an import, alter the digest signature, record a wrong toolchain/hash in the receipt, or name a compiler other than the one Cargo was told to use. Task 010 (the lab name is cc-capsule-identity's lab CID, through wasm_capsule_tools::bundle_identity): the manifest gets a lab schema, a wrong entrypoint, a drifted version or one changed description byte; the tools crate gets a naming function of its own or a second import of the shared function; the reproducibility copy stops reaching the out-of-lane path dependencies, so the named test fails at its assertion that the copy's tools/build succeeded, with cargo's "failed to load manifest" error in the child build's output. 007's lane-own name rule (PR #105) and its 24 falsifiers were retired by task 010; cc-capsule-identity's own tests and falsifiers cover the walk and the encoding. command is "lab" and file paths are relative to examples/agent-host/, so a lab file is ../../lab/wasm-capsule/... . The canonical runner falsify.py has no "lab" command yet (ask R1), so these are hand-proven, pending R1: proved by the repo's break -> named test fails -> revert method with `cargo test` in the lab workspace until R1 lands.
